I fixed `slugify` in `src/slugify.py`, but I haven't run the tests. Bash was denied in this session, so I only traced the five cases in `tests/test_slugify.py` by hand.

The old regex replaced every non-alphanumeric character with its own dash and left dashes on the ends. So `"  a   b  "` came out as `a---b`, and `"C++ rocks!"` as `c---rocks-`. Two tests expect `a-b` and `c-rocks`, so those would have failed.

The change is one line:

```python
return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")
```

By my trace, all five tests now pass. `truncate` was already correct.

I guessed that the slugify tests are what "isn't working". If you meant something else, such as the changes to `harness/tools.py` in your git status, tell me which and I'll look there. You can run `pytest` yourself to confirm, or allow Bash and I'll run it.
